source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
completion:
Review air pollution control measures and parameters.
3. Assess the types of pollutants emitted.
4. Compare the emissions with regulatory standards.
5. Identify the duration and frequency of excessive emissions.
6. Document meteorological conditions.
7. Record the location(s) and source(s) of emissions accurately.
8. Use precise measurement units and formats.
9. Verify the data's accuracy through cross-referencing.
10. Note any calibration and maintenance records of monitoring equipment.
11. Provide details of any additional measurements taken, such as stack tests.
12. Include the method of emission measurement.
13. Summarize findings and note any deviations from normal operation.
14. Make suggestions for mitigation and improvement.
15. Provide photographic evidence, if available.
16. Attach any related studies or reports.
17. Maintain confidentiality of sensitive data, if necessary.
18. Sign off on the report, indicating responsibility for the contents.
19. Submit the report to the relevant authorities
